name: Trip Manager
responsibility: Turns the request into a bounded work plan, assigns specialists, and routes critic feedback to the responsible agent.

name: Destination Agent
responsibility: Selects locally catalogued places, builds day-by-day activities, and keeps each day's route geographically sensible.

name: Budget Agent
responsibility: Checks a local per-person cost estimate against the user's total group budget and explains cost trade-offs.

name: Weather Agent
responsibility: Uses bundled typical-climate data to identify weather-sensitive activities and indoor alternatives.

name: Critic Agent
responsibility: Checks itinerary coverage, budget arithmetic, seasonal risks and constraint conflicts; can reject and request targeted re-planning.
